email_attempts.subject: Evidence collection across ISO 27001 and HIPAA
email_attempts.body:
Hi Jamie,

I saw on Linear's security page that your team maintains multiple compliance standards, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and HIPAA.

With multiple frameworks in place, recurringly gathering and validating audit artifacts might require ongoing cross-functional coordination that takes focus away from core security initiatives.

Sprinto helps security leads address this through automated evidence collection, continuously pulling live proof from your tech stack and automatically mapping it to overlapping controls across standards.

Would you be open to a brief chat next week to explore how this works?

Best,
Namratha
